title: Sequential exponential-motivic periods in spatially cut-off $φ^4_2$
summary: We represent constructive integrals in spatially cut-off $φ^4_2$ by sequences of exponential-motivic periods. For a nonzero spatial cutoff, a single Galois transformation makes the partition periods diverge in modulus along every sequence of approximations satisfying the constructive estimates. For a fixed cutoff presentation, we characterize the subgroup of transformations admitting a bounded realization on the free field's $L^1$ space and prove that all fixed-observable limits on this subgroup are a common scalar multiple of their physical values.
